needAdmin: Changing the configuration needs an administrator account.
systemManaged: Managed by the system (systemd-networkd). Axia DE shows it but does not change it. If you hand it over to Axia DE, the system stops configuring it: only do this if it is not the connection you use to manage this computer remotely.
vpn.enableHint: {name} is optional and not installed. Enabling it installs the free Debian client ({pkg}) with the Axia DE package engine. Nothing from Cisco or Fortinet is installed.
vpn.field.routes: Networks through the VPN (empty: all traffic)
vpn.importHint: Pick the file your provider gave you: a WireGuard .conf or an OpenVPN .ovpn (its certificates are read from the same folder). Keys are stored for root only and the interface never sees them again.
vpn.name: Name
vpn.noFiles: No .conf or .ovpn files in your home, Downloads, Documents or Desktop folders.
vpn.none: No VPNs configured. Add one: WireGuard or OpenVPN from its file, or IPsec, PPTP, AnyConnect or Fortinet with its details.
vpn.pptpWarning: PPTP is obsolete and insecure (MS-CHAPv2 and MPPE are easy to break). Only use it if the server offers nothing else.
vpnInterface: This is a VPN interface: manage it from VPN.
wifi.noSae: This network requires WPA3 and the adapter does not support it.
wifi.none: This computer has no Wi-Fi adapter.
